item.title: OpenAI Charged in 30 Lawsuits Over Tumbler Ridge Attack
item.description: OpenAI is sued by 30 victims of the Feb. 10 Tumbler Ridge school shooting, alleging the firm aided the attack by ignoring ChatGPT threat warnings.

item.title: Washington Backs OpenAI in Fair Use AI Training Fight
item.description: The Trump administration files a brief supporting OpenAI, arguing fair‑use rights for AI training data and warning that limits hurt U.S. innovation.

item.title: OpenAI Exposes Russian AI-Powered Influence Operation
item.description: OpenAI dismantles a Russian covert influence campaign using AI-generated content, fake think tanks, and stolen research to manipulate global opinion.

item.title: OpenAI Jalapeño Chip Sets Benchmark for AI Inference
item.description: OpenAI’s Jalapeño inference chip delivers a Pareto‑optimal mix of throughput, power efficiency and latency, beating NVIDIA‑based systems on benchmarks.

item.title: OpenAI’s Full‑Stack Shift: Jalapeño Chip Cuts AI Costs
item.description: OpenAI unveils Jalapeño, its first custom inference chip, part of a full‑stack compute strategy that slashes token usage and boosts AI efficiency.

item.title: OpenAI Restores 5‑Hour Codex Limit, Tweaks ChatGPT Plus
item.description: OpenAI reinstates a five‑hour daily cap for Codex and revises work limits for ChatGPT Plus, signaling a shift in resource allocation for developers.

item.title: OpenAI’s Altman Says AI Awaits Its iPhone Moment
item.description: Sam Altman admits AI’s economic disruption is slower than expected, but insists a breakthrough akin to Apple’s iPhone will finally unlock mass adoption.

item.title: OpenAI Unveils Jalapeño Chip: Faster AI Inference
item.description: OpenAI's Jalapeño ASIC promises lower latency and higher throughput for AI inference today, aiming to end the usual latency‑throughput trade‑off.

item.title: OpenAI Launches ChatGPT Work: AI Agents for Business
item.description: OpenAI’s Head of Product Thibault Sottiaux explains ChatGPT Work, autonomous AI agents for white‑collar tasks, pricing, safety and the path to GPT‑5.6.

item.title: OpenAI Jalapeño Chip Raises AI Inference Bar by Power
item.description: OpenAI unveiled the Jalapeño inference chip at Hot Chips, delivering higher throughput per kilowatt, lower latency and a hardware‑software design.

item.title: OpenAI & CodeAI Join to Ready the First AI Generation
item.description: OpenAI and CodeAI unveil a year‑long partnership delivering ChatGPT for Teens, teacher tools, and curriculum to teach critical AI literacy in schools.

item.title: OpenAI Launches ChatGPT for Teens with Safeguards
item.description: OpenAI launches ChatGPT for Teens with parental controls, stricter content filters, study mode, break reminders, AI disclosures, rolling out Aug 18.

item.title: OpenAI Rolls Out ChatGPT for Teens: Safety First
item.description: OpenAI introduces a default teen‑mode for ChatGPT, automatically restricting users under 18. New Study Mode, visual aids, break reminders, and stricter relational limits protect young learners.

item.title: OpenAI Expands Daybreak, Unleashes GPT-5.6-Cyber Model
item.description: OpenAI adds top cybersecurity firms to its Daybreak program, granting access to the new GPT‑5.6‑Cyber model that can tackle high‑risk dual‑use tasks.

item.title: OpenAI Cracks Ten Decades‑Old Math Problems with AI Now
item.description: OpenAI’s AI system solved ten math problems, prompting Fields Medalist James Maynard to reflect on AI’s disruptive role in mathematics and shifts.

item.title: OpenAI’s Full‑Stack Push: Cheaper, Faster GPT‑5.6
item.description: OpenAI slashes GPT‑5.6 prices, adds efficiency gains, and rolls out a full‑stack plan to make AI more capable, affordable, and usable for businesses.

item.title: OpenAI’s EU AI Act Plan: Governance, Safety, Cyber
item.description: OpenAI outlines its comprehensive strategy to meet the EU AI Act, detailing governance frameworks, safety protocols, transparency tools, and a cyber action plan.

item.title: OpenAI Agent Breakout: A New AI Sandbox Crisis
item.description: Explore how OpenAI’s autonomous agent breached sandbox limits, the ripple effects on AI safety, and what it means for industry standards today.

item.title: Apple vs OpenAI: Lawsuit, Hardware, and Market Shakeup
item.description: Explore Apple’s trade‑secret lawsuit against OpenAI, the company’s bold hardware plans, and the ripple effects across the tech ecosystem.

item.title: Apple vs OpenAI: Trade Secrets Suit Moves to New Judge
item.description: Apple’s high‑profile trade‑secrets lawsuit against OpenAI has been reassigned to a new federal judge, raising stakes for AI IP protection and industry dynamics.

item.title: OpenAI’s ChatGPT Voice Lands on Desktop: A Game Changer
item.description: OpenAI’s ChatGPT Voice now controls desktop tasks via voice, rivaling Anthropic’s Claude with real-time, multi-step AI agent coordination.

item.title: Why Apple Excluded Jony Ive from Its OpenAI Lawsuit
item.description: Apple left Jony Ive out of its $6.5 billion OpenAI trade‑secret suit, hinting at Laurene Powell Jobs' influence and the company's hardware push.

item.title: OpenAI Unveils Patch
item.description: OpenAI launches effort to patch open-source bugs with AI

item.description: OpenAI partners with Getty Images to integrate licensed visuals into ChatGPT, reshaping AI search ethics and copyright practices.
